question: Should the Wave 2+ modular dashboard roadmap remain bundled OpenClaw Control UI/Gateway work, and which child slices should instead move to plugin, skill, or ClawHub ownership?
rationale: The linked work crosses custom widget sandboxing, write-back persistence, install/publish trust, role visibility, Gateway RPC, and plugin API boundaries that cleanup automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Review Stack Base-First
options.body: Keep this tracker open and review the linked child issues and PRs one by one with explicit security, storage, upgrade, and plugin-boundary decisions.

options.title: Move Optional Slices Outward
options.body: Retain only generic core/API seams in OpenClaw and ask optional widget packs, skills, registries, or tab-app bundles to ship through plugin or ClawHub paths.

options.title: Defer Dashboard Wave 2
options.body: Pause or close the roadmap if maintainers decide bundled modular dashboard expansion is not current product work.

recommendation.title: Review Stack Base-First
recommendation.body: Keep this tracker open and review the linked child issues and PRs one by one with explicit security, storage, upgrade, and plugin-boundary decisions.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is product and security direction for the Control UI/plugin-tab seam that steipete recently introduced through PR 99930.
